name: Alsenz (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Alsenz (a blue lion on white, a yellow lion on blue and waves on green).
history: The municipal arms are placed centrally on the green, white and green striped hoisted flag approved on 25 September 1975.

features.role: Alsenz arms — two lions and waves
